```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load a toy dataset

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
devtools::install_git("git@gitlab.data.trade.gov.uk:dbt-data-visualisation-library/dbtplotr.git", upgrade = 'never')
library(dbtplotr)

conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres())

## ONS UK Total Trade
ons_trade <- dbGetQuery(conn,'
SELECT *
FROM ons.trade__uk_totals_sa
;')


df1 <- ons_trade %>%
  filter(period_type == 'year', ons_region_name == 'South Korea', period >= '2010', product_name == 'goods')


df2 <- ons_trade %>%
  filter(period %in% c('2022'), product_name == 'goods', direction== 'imports', value > 100,
         ons_region_name %in% c('Bangladesh', 'Poland','Brazil','Australia','Mexico','India'))

```

## Without a theme (the default ggplot)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df1, aes(x = period, y = value, group = direction)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = direction)) +
  labs(title = "UK Trade with South Korea, 2010-2022",
       subtitle = "Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet",
       caption = "Source: ONS",
       x = "",
       y = "Value, £m",
       color = "Direction")

ggsave("../man/figures/without_dbtplotr.png")
```
## With DBT theme for {ggplot}

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df1, aes(x = period, y = value, group = direction)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = direction)) +
  labs(title = "UK Trade with South Korea, 2010-2022",
       subtitle = "Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet",
       caption = "Source: ONS",
       x = "",
       y = "Value, £m",
       color = "Direction") +
  dbtplotr::theme_dbt()

ggsave("../man/figures/with_dbtplotr.png")
```
## With DBT theme for {ggplot} and colours

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df1, aes(x = period, y = value, group = direction)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = direction)) +
  labs(title = "UK Trade with South Korea, 2010-2022",
       subtitle = "Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet",
       caption = "Source: ONS",
       x = "",
       y = "Value, £m",
       color = "Direction") +
  dbtplotr::theme_dbt() +
  dbtplotr::colours_dbt(type = 'line', palette = 'gaf')

ggsave("../man/figures/with_dbtplotr_colour.png")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df2, aes(x = ons_region_name, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
  labs(title = "UK Imports from selected countries, 2022",
       subtitle = "Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet",
       caption = "Source: ONS",
       x = "",
       y = "Value, £m") +
  dbtplotr::theme_dbt()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df2, aes(x = ons_region_name, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "UK Imports from selected countries, 2022",
       subtitle = "Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet",
       caption = "Source: ONS",
       x = "",
       y = "Value, £m") +
  dbtplotr::theme_dbt(gridline = 'x')
```


## Plotly
## Without a theme (the default plotly)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(df1,
        x = ~period,
        y = ~value,
        color = ~direction,
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'lines+markers') %>%
  layout(title = list(text = '<b>UK Trade with South Korea since 2010</b><br>Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet'),
         xaxis = list(title = list(text = '')),
         yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Value, £m'),
                      tickformat = ',')) 

ggsave("../man/figures/default_plotly.png")
```

## With DBT theme for {plotly}
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(df1,
        x = ~period,
        y = ~value,
        color = ~direction, colors = dbtplotr::dbt_palettes[["gaf2"]],
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'lines+markers') %>%
  layout(title = list(text = '<b>UK Trade with South Korea since 2010</b><br>Ipsum Lorem dolor sit amet'),
         xaxis = list(title = list(text = '')),
         yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Value, £m'),
                      tickformat = ',')) %>% 
  theme_dbt_plotly()

ggsave("../man/figures/with_theme_dbt_plotly.png")
```
